descriptionByLocale.it:
Compiti:
• Supportano il nostro team in una moderna cardiologia che copre l'intero spettro di cardiologia invasiva e non invasiva al massimo livello (coronarografie, Mitraclip, TAVI, PFO/ASD/LAA chiusure).

• Essi svolgono in modo indipendente interventi interventi sui coronari utilizzando le ultime tecniche.

• Insieme ai medici dei quadri, lei è responsabile della supervisione e dell'ulteriore educazione dei nostri medici assistenti.

• Eseguono compiti di leadership e sviluppano attivamente la cardiologia, in particolare il campo della cardiologia interventistica.

• Fanno parte del team di background cardiologia e partecipano attivamente a colloqui, rapport e visite.

• La manutenzione corrotta del contatto con i medici assegnanti sia internamente che esternamente fa parte dei vostri compiti quotidiani.

Requisiti
• Come personalità impegnata e comunicativa, attribuisci importanza ad una collaborazione collegiale, professionale e costruttiva.

• Porti un diploma medico svizzero o un'educazione equivalente con riconoscimento MEBEKO e hai già un titolo specialistico FMH Cardiologia.

• Inoltre, avete un'esperienza clinica approfondita con un focus sulla cardiologia interventistica (interventi corianali e, se necessario, interventi strutturali).

• Oltre alla competenza professionale, ci aspettiamo un alto livello di competenza sociale, che è un presupposto per l'esercizio di successo di questa posizione interessante e versatile.

• La condivisione parziale del lavoro è possibile con un accordo.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks:
• They support our team in a modern cardiology that covers the entire spectrum of invasive and non-invasive cardiology at the highest level (coronarographies, Mitraclips, TAVI, PFO/ASD/LAA closures).

• They independently perform interventional interventions on the coronaries using the latest techniques.

• Together with the cadre doctors, you are responsible for the supervision and further education of our assistant doctors.

• They perform leadership tasks and actively develop cardiology, especially the field of interventional cardiology.

• They are part of the cardiology background team and actively participate in colloquia, rapports and visits.

• The brisk maintenance of contact with the assigning doctors both internally and externally is part of your daily tasks.

Requirements
• As a committed, communicative personality, you attach importance to a collegial, professional and constructive cooperation.

• You bring a Swiss medical diploma or an equivalent education with recognition MEBEKO and already have a specialist title FMH Cardiology.

• Furthermore, you have in-depth clinical experience with a focus on interventional cardiology (coronary interventions and, if necessary, structural interventions).

• In addition to professional competence, we expect a high level of social competence, which is a prerequisite for the successful exercise of this interesting and versatile position.

• Part-time job sharing is possible by agreement.

Stellenantritt: nach Vereinbarung, unbefristet

Aufgaben:
Als Berufsbildende / Berufsbildender arbeiten Sie mit Lernenden (FaGe) und Studierenden (Pflege HF und FH) zusammen und sorgen gemeinsam für eine patientenorientierte und professionelle Pflege. Dabei sind Sie für die Planung, die Gestaltung, die Dokumentation und die Evaluation des gesamten Lernprozesses der Lernenden/Studierenden zuständig und beteiligen sich als Experte/Expertin an den Ausbildungsabschlüssen. Sie führen mit den Lernenden/Studierenden Bildungszonen und befähigen sie für den beruflichen Pflegealltag. Den diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen bieten Sie Beratung und Unterstützung in Ausbildungsfragen und führen neue Mitarbeitende in die Tagesbegleitung von Lernenden/Studierenden ein. In Ihrer Funktion arbeiten Sie eng mit der Fachabteilung Berufsbildung zusammen. Auf der Abteilung sind Sie gemeinsam mit der Stationsleitung und den Fachexperten für die Organisation und Weiterentwicklung der Abteilung mitverantwortlich.

Anforderungen:
Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als diplomierte Pflegefachfrau / Pflegefachmann (HF/FH) mit mindestens zwei Jahren Berufserfahrung. Wenn Sie eine pädagogische Weiterbildung vorweisen können oder bereit sind, diese zu absolvieren, dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig. Idealerweise haben Sie bereits Erfahrung als Tagesbegleitperson gesammelt. Vorausgesetzt wird eine ausgewiesene hohe Fach-kompetenz in der Pflege, Teamfähigkeit sowie gute mündliche und schriftliche Ausdrucksfähigkeit. Sie setzen sich engagiert für den Pflegeberuf ein und sind sich Ihrer Vorbildfunktion bewusst. Ihr Umgang mit Lernenden/Studierenden ist verständnisvoll, kooperativ und zielorientiert. Sie sind motiviert die Lernenden/Studierenden im Erreichen der Handlungskompetenzen zu fördern und zu begleiten. Sie zeichnen sich durch gute Organisationsfähigkeit, hohe Sozial- und Selbstkompetenz aus und sind versiert im Umgang mit den gängigen Office-Anwendungen.

descriptionByLocale.de: Sie erhalten einen ersten Einblick in die Praxis der Gesundheitsberufe. Ernsthafte Berufswünsche können Sie abklären. Sie lernen den Alltag einer Medizinischen Praxisassistentin kennen. Die Möglichkeiten richten sich nach dem Angebot des Betriebs. Das Mindestalter für ein Berufswahlpraktikum beträgt 14 Jahre bzw. Schülerinnen und Schüler ab der 2. Oberstufe (8. Klasse). Die Dauer des Berufswahlpraktikums beträgt 1 Tag. Voraussetzung: Sekundar- oder Bezirksschule. Nur Bewerbungen aus dem Kanton Aargau sowie aus der Agglomeration Aarau (Olten, Lostorf, Winznau, Gösgen, Gretzenbach, Erlinsbach). Wir empfehlen einen Anfahrtsweg von maximal 45 Minuten. Mögliche Einsatzorte: KSA am Bahnhof (Praxiszentrum und Frauenarztpraxis), Ambulatorium Kinder-, Jugendklinik oder weitere. Der Einsatzort kann nicht frei gewählt werden, es erfolgt eine Einteilung je nach Angebot.
descriptionByLocale.it: Si otterrà una prima visione della pratica delle professioni sanitarie. Puoi chiarire seri desideri di carriera. Conosci la vita quotidiana di un assistente medico. Le possibilità dipendono dall'offerta della struttura. L'età minima per un tirocinio elettivo professionale è di 14 anni o alunni del secondo livello superiore (8 ° grado). La durata dello stage professionale è di 1 giorno. Prerequisito: scuola secondaria o di distretto. Solo applicazioni dal cantone di Aargau e dall'agglomerato Aarau (Olten, Lostorf, Winznau, Gösgen, Gretzenbach, Erlinsbach). Consigliamo un viaggio massimo di 45 minuti. Possibili sedi: KSA alla stazione ferroviaria (centro di pratica e ginecologo), ambulatorium per bambini clinica, clinica giovanile o altri. La posizione di utilizzo non può essere scelta liberamente, una divisione avviene a seconda dell'offerta.

The Canton Hospital Aarau (KSA) is seeking a skilled Service-/Maintenance Technician Heating-Cooling to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and installation of heating, ventilation, air conditioning (HVAC), and refrigeration systems in our hospital facilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background, excellent problem-solving skills, and a commitment to ensuring the smooth operation of critical infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:
- Perform routine and preventive maintenance on HVAC and refrigeration systems.
- Conduct repairs and troubleshooting of heating, cooling, and refrigeration equipment.
- Install and commission new HVAC and refrigeration systems.
- Ensure compliance with safety regulations and hospital standards.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical issues.
- Document maintenance activities and system performance.
- Participate in emergency response and system breakdown management.

Requirements:
- Completed vocational training or equivalent in HVAC or refrigeration technology.
- Several years of experience in HVAC and refrigeration maintenance.
- Knowledge of relevant safety regulations and hospital standards.
- Strong technical skills and hands-on problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Good communication skills in German and English.
- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel.

We offer:
- A dynamic and challenging work environment in a leading healthcare institution.
- Competitive salary and benefits.
- Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
- A supportive and collaborative team.

• Idealmente, hai le certificazioni ServiceNow (ad esempio CSA, CIS in ITSM/CSM/ Discovery) e l'esperienza con lo scripting (JavaScript), le integrazioni (REST/SOAP), CMDB e la gestione del rilascio/test.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Tasks:
• They operate, configure and optimize the ServiceNow platform (including incident, problem, change, request, service catalog) and ensure stable operation.

• They analyze faults, fix errors (2nd/3rd level) and support the departments in the efficient use of ServiceNow.

• They implement the requirements in the form of configurations, workflows, business rules, UI policies, ACLs and integrations and document them in a comprehensible manner.

• Requirements Engineering in cooperation with process managers and key users: They take up the needs, assess them for feasibility and translate them into feasible technical solutions. They maintain and develop the service portfolio in ServiceNow, support releases/upgrades, carry out tests and accompany deployments into the productive environment. You consistently pay attention to governance, security and compliance requirements.

• They work in ICT and digitization projects and, if necessary, take over (partial) project management around ServiceNow (e.g. new modules, self-service, CMDB/Discovery).

• They create dashboards and reports, analyze KPIs and derive optimizations for processes and automation.

• They support the setup and maintenance of interfaces (e.g. via REST/SOAP, MID server) as well as the integration of adjacent systems.

Requirements
• You have completed training in computer science (EFZ) or a comparable qualification.

• You have several years of experience in the operation and further development of ServiceNow solutions.

• They know ITIL processes very well and can translate the requirements into technical implementations (configuration/customizing, workflow/flow design).

• Ideally, you have ServiceNow certifications (e.g. CSA, CIS in ITSM/CSM/ Discovery) and experience with scripting (JavaScript), integrations (REST/SOAP), CMDB and release/test management.

• They work in a structured, analytical and solution-oriented way, like to take on responsibility and communicate securely with different stakeholders.

• You have very good knowledge of German, English skills are an advantage.
